description: Lists the Mastering presets saved on the account, newest first (GET /mastering/presets), with their full settings, plus the ids of the read-only built-in presets (builtin:balanced, ...) which are valid as the `preset` of jj_master_audio. No pagination: an account keeps 50 presets at most. Open to any account, free or Premium. Counts one unit of the daily read quota.
name: jj_list_mastering_presets
title: List Mastering presets
